/bin/bash -lc "cat >> .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'

Root cause: configdata.yml rejects "'`overlay`; `_qtwebengine_args` never emits the Chromium feature flag; boolean migration maps False to `when-searching`; BDD tag handling has no `js_headers` marker. Header update code in webenginesettings.py identifies Qt 5.12 through 5.14 as broken for runtime header updates. Hypothesis: adding the option, one guarded yield in the QtWebEngine argument path, corrected migration, and a version-aware BDD marker resolves each behavior.
EOF
python -m pytest --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -p no:xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py tests/unit/config/test_configfiles.py tests/end2end/test_markers.py --maxfail=1'
/bin/bash -lc "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py -k 'overlay_scrollbar or chromium_debug or disable_gpu'"
/bin/bash -lc "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest --no-xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py -k 'overlay_scrollbar or chromium_debug or disable_gpu'"
/bin/bash -lc 'DISPLAY=:1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest --no-xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py tests/unit/config/test_configfiles.py tests/end2end/test_markers.py --maxfail=1'
/bin/bash -lc "DISPLAY=:1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest --no-xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py -k 'overlay_scrollbar or chromium_debug or disable_gpu'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '710,790p' tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py
grep -n 'test_new_chromium' tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py
DISPLAY=:1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest --no-xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configfiles.py"

DISPLAY=:1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest --no-xvfb -q tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py -k 'not test_new_chromium'"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
